subject.title: fix(signal): expose mention facts in inbound context

question: Should OpenClaw expose these Signal mention-gating decision facts as generic plugin SDK prompt-context fields now?
rationale: The code path is coherent, but the new MsgContext fields and MentionSource literal become a durable plugin/prompt contract and should be maintainer-owned.

options.title: Accept Additive Context Contract
options.body: Merge after the Signal native mention-gating prerequisite lands and keep these names as the delivered-turn mention diagnostics contract.

options.title: Narrow The Public Surface
options.body: Ask for fewer fields, different names, or docs-only diagnostics if maintainers want a smaller long-term SDK surface.

options.title: Keep Facts Signal-Internal
options.body: Decline the SDK surface for now and keep native/text mention facts inside Signal tests or logging until a broader channel contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Accept Additive Context Contract
recommendation.body: Merge after the Signal native mention-gating prerequisite lands and keep these names as the delivered-turn mention diagnostics contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent plugin SDK and channel-context review history makes this the closest owner signal for the public contract decision.
